hw.text: No measured hardware profile for these cards yet: memory sizes and bandwidth are catalog (datasheet) values, rates are borrowed from the nearest measured card. Every figure below is an estimate; the first boot on this hardware is the measurement.

layouts.name: Solo (TP only)
layouts.satz: All cards work as one tensor-parallel group that prefills and decodes; no switching, no front.
why: 1 card: a flip or dual needs two groups over at least two cards, and the single-group mode for one card (the decode group alone behind the front, with a model fit check before load) does not exist yet (plan P4) (not supported yet).
does not fit by the rough calculation: short by 19.2 GiB

layouts.name: Flip
layouts.satz: The same cards work alternately as prefill group P (pipeline) and decode group D (tensor-parallel); the weights are exchanged through the host.
why: 1 card: a flip or dual needs two groups over at least two cards, and the single-group mode for one card (the decode group alone behind the front, with a model fit check before load) does not exist yet (plan P4) (not supported yet).

layouts.name: Dual
layouts.satz: P and D are awake at the same time on the same cards; no switching, but both layouts hold weights at once.
why: 1 card: a flip or dual needs two groups over at least two cards, and the single-group mode for one card (the decode group alone behind the front, with a model fit check before load) does not exist yet (plan P4) (not supported yet).
Dual is calibrated on the NVFP4 weights only (the launcher's dual form has no INT8 reference profile).
